codex_note:
## Codex adaptation boundary

The bundled [native hook adapter](scripts/cursor_native_hook_adapters.py) has synthetic event tests for patch markers, advisor identity/verdict, one-time Stop nudges, and explicit task-bound enable/status/expected-agent/disable. It does not register a project hook, trust it, or invoke an advisor. The source below still contains Cursor-specific model defaults, state paths, Task fields, and custom-mode behavior. Do not use those commands in Codex as written. The pinned [advisor role](references/advisor-subagent.md) is bundled as an instruction reference; native read-only permission still requires the selected host surface. Explicit operator-selected model/effort and a live consult are required before this skill can be indexed. Never enable advisor mode without a user trigger.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
